topic: An artist discovers someone has tattooed their work
text: I see the marks, bold and uninvited, on what was once mine. Yet, as I gaze, there's a pulse, a breath of life they bring. The lines, though foreign, speak of passion, a mirror of my own. They’ve taken what I gave the world and made it theirs, a bold step, a leap of faith, perhaps. It’s a strange dance, this merging of souls, a testament to the art that swells beyond the canvas. I am moved, not by the act but by the echo of my creation in another’s heart. It whispers, and I listen, finding in their bold strokes a reflection of something deep, unsaid, and shared.
